findings.title: Claim waits for a pod that bypasses the scheduler
findings.cause: claim data's StorageClass standard provisions a volume only once the scheduler places the pod that uses it, and the pod sets nodeName kd-faults-control-plane, which bypasses the scheduler, so the claim never binds and the pod never starts; Deployment db has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.command: kubectl get pod db-68946d5798-qvmw6 -n kd-nodename-bypasses-binding -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeName}'

evidence.what: claim data is Pending, with no volume.kubernetes.io/selected-node annotation
evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-nodename-bypasses-binding -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}{" "}{.metadata.annotations}'

findings.fix: Remove nodeName from the pod template and use a nodeSelector on kubernetes.io/hostname instead, so the scheduler places the pod and the claim binds on that node.
